- Can Healthly be put on Net60 for the pilot (three monthly invoices)?

- Requesting a €120k credit limit (to cover monthly consumption spikes) for the first 90 days, then review.

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing terms request for pilot (PO attached)

Hi Claire — thanks for the PO and the VAT doc. Quick response from our side with a proposal that should help both teams move quickly: 

Proposal (pilot / first 90 days):
- Offer: Conditional Net45 standard term with an early-pay discount (2% if paid within 10 days).
- For the first 3 months we can agree to invoice monthly but accept Net60 on the accounting record if Healthly provides the 15% upfront deposit (applied to final invoice) or a confirmed payment guarantee. This lets us keep operational capacity while giving Finance the longer window they want.
- Credit cap: provisional €80k for month 1, review at 45 days against consumption and PO-backed forecast. If Healthly needs a hard €120k cap we will require trade references + signed credit addendum.
- VAT: we will show VAT separately on invoices as requested; final reconciliation requires the VAT registration extract and a named billing entity.

Mutual actions I propose: 
1) Healthly countersigns the PO and confirms the legal billing entity name (matching VAT doc).
2) Healthly provides either the 15% deposit or a confirmed payment guarantee (bank/parent guarantee).
3) We prepare a short credit addendum (1 page) — I will loop in Finance.

I CC'd Vanessa to assist with the operational side and to get you a provisional invoice stub so procurement can process. If the deposit route is a blocker I can engage Marcus in Finance to discuss staggered triggers instead.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference
+1 415 555 0123

Attachment: Provisional_Invoice_Redwood_4532.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing terms request for pilot (PO attached) — Finance stance

Hannah / Vanessa,

Looping in formal finance requirements so we don't have surprises during onboarding. High level: we can support an initial operational accommodation, but need controls. My suggested stance to present to Healthly: 

1) VAT evidence: must have entity-level VAT registration (we have that from Claire) and the billing/legal entity must match the VAT record.
2) Deposit vs. Guarantee: 15% deposit is the fastest; if they provide a parent or bank guarantee we'll accept that instead.
3) Credit cap: set provisional cap at €75,000 for first month, escalated to €120,000 after 45 days if: consumption forecast provided AND no material billing exceptions.
4) Net terms mechanics: we can issue invoices with Net45 as our standard. For accounting teams that need Net60, we can accommodate an accounting notation of Net60 but require the 15% deposit OR a signed credit addendum that includes a fee schedule (0.5% per 30 days overdue beyond Net45).
5) Staggered settlement alternative: if deposit is not possible, we require first invoice 50% upfront, remaining 50% on Net30.

I will prepare a one-page credit addendum and a DocuSign envelope if they prefer to sign. Please share the exact legal name and I will draft.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.inference

Thanks for the clear options. We can do the 15% deposit for the pilot (I have approval from Finance), and we accept the Net45 as Redwood’s standard with the accounting team documenting Net60 on their side for internal cashflow reporting for the first three invoices. Two clarifications: 

- Healthly will retain Net60 accounting on our ledger for invoices 1–3 only; after that we revert to Net45 unless otherwise agreed.
- We would prefer the provisional credit cap to be set at €100k rather than €75k while the pilot runs; if you can do €100k we will provide trade references + an executive confirmation email.

Attached: signed PO (Healthly_PO_4532.pdf). Please confirm the bank details for the deposit and the DocuSign credit addendum when it's ready.
